brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall
requirements.evidence: 3 cells in a row (-1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0) joined with side-connector-single, with two keyhole hangers (accessory:0#-1,0#4 and accessory:0#1,0#4 hex-acc-keyhole) on rear face (slot 4) for screw-mount wall hanging; build sized 500×80×375 mm, open faces capped and joints locked.

requirements.requirement: With hooks for small hand tools
requirements.evidence: Six hex-acc-hook plates installed on front faces: 3 on slot 1 (accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1) and 3 on slot 2 (accessory:0#-1,0#2, accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#1,0#2). Each plate carries two hooks side-by-side = 12 hooks total for pliers, screwdrivers, tape, etc.
Used hex-acc-keyhole accessories specifically, not French cleat or bracket; description confirms hanging on screws already in wall.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell horizontal wall rack (500 mm wide) with two keyhole hangers on the rear for wall mounting and six double-hook plates (12 hooks) across the two front faces for small hand tools. Joints connected and locked, remaining open faces capped. Bench preview cannot demonstrate hanging props (cable-coil/tape hang 25-35 mm below the bench at level 0), but the wall-mounted geometry provides the required hook array.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
